title: Introduction to Big Data
standfirst: Distributed storage and computation — the ideas behind Hadoop, Spark and the modern data stack.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces the practical aspects of large-scale analytics (big data), beginning with foundational concepts in big data and cloud computing across hardware, systems, and software, and progressing to algorithm design and execution at scale.
faculty: Dr. Rangarajan Vasudevan, Co-Founder & Chief Data Officer, Lentre.ai

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Big data fundamentals; Cloud and Spark; MapReduce concepts; Sorting and hashing.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Cloud fundamentals; Cloud-native architecture; Cloud services; Big data in cloud.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Data pipelines; Data formats; Relational vs non-relational data; Data lakes and warehouses; Data extraction.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Hadoop and Spark; Spark architecture; Spark SQL and streaming; Hands-on data processing.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: ETL/ELT; Data processing patterns; Metadata and lifecycle; Scheduling.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: SQL and relational algebra; Query planning and optimization; Join algorithms; Spark SQL optimization; NoSQL databases.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Streaming vs batch; Streaming fundamentals; Pub/Sub; Dataflow and Beam.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Kafka architecture; Message semantics; Exactly-once processing; Spark streaming; Windowing and real-time processing.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Big data ML; Distributed ML; Spark MLlib; MLOps; Best practices.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Deep learning on big data; Distributed training; Streaming inference; Course recap.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Prep week for final project; Summarizing key concepts.
